title: Pure rapid-drainage head/resistance/potential-flux equation

source.path: SWAP/macrorate.f90:RAPIDDRAIN head, resistance and potential-flux calculation
source.behavior: Calculate drain head difference with the near-surface pond correction; clamp at zero; above the strict Kd threshold calculate capped resistance scaling and reduction-weighted flux; cap flux by drainable storage.

scope: scalar potential flux and resistance with all source inputs explicit
strict Kd > 1e-10 branch and pond-head threshold order
storage cap and deterministic source-order arithmetic
100,000 deterministic bitwise comparisons at O0 and O2
non_goals: compartment flux distribution and post-rate acceptance
mass receipt, retry/restart, Richards owner or production admission
